'''Surcaris''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Trans-Vulta sector/Legends|Trans-Vulta sector]] where a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], possibly under [[Munin Skirata]], fought. It was also the location where Munin found a young [[Kal Skirata]].
